# ---- Master/RenbanGroup combined grid builder — inline runPrepQuery (Order-spike pattern) ----
	# Executes the canonical RenbanGroup/list SQL from master-crud-namedqueries.sql via
	# system.db.runPrepQuery. IG81-COMPAT: plain parameterized T-SQL; runs identically on 8.1.52 and 8.3.
	log = system.util.getLogger("SPIKE")
	DB = "Inventory_Spike"
	parts = unicode(value).split("|")
	searchTerm = parts[0]
	siteId = int(float(parts[1]))   # IG-SITE: plumbed through view->query; predicate still commented (D1)

	sql = ("SELECT  IN_RENBAN_ID           AS RecordID, "
	       "        VC_RENBAN_GROUP_CODE   AS RenbanGroupCode, "
	       "        VC_RENBAN_GROUP_COUNT  AS Count, "
	       "        IN_SHIP_DAYS           AS ShipDays "
	       "FROM    INV_RENBAN_GROUP_MST "
	       "WHERE  (? = '' OR VC_RENBAN_GROUP_CODE LIKE '%' + ? + '%') "
	       "-- IG-SITE:  AND site_id = ? "
	       "ORDER BY VC_RENBAN_GROUP_CODE")
	ds = system.db.runPrepQuery(sql, [searchTerm, searchTerm], DB)
	log.info("SPIKE RenbanGroup/list: %d rows (search='%s' site=%d)" % (ds.rowCount, searchTerm, siteId))

	columns = [
		{"field": "RenbanGroupCode", "header": {"title": "Renban Group Code"}, "strictWidth": 150, "sort": "ascending"},
		{"field": "Count",           "header": {"title": "Count"}, "strictWidth": 90},
		{"field": "ShipDays",        "header": {"title": "Ship Days"}, "strictWidth": 100},
		{"field": "RecordID",        "header": {"title": "id"}, "visible": False}
	]
	rows = []
	for r in xrange(ds.rowCount):
		rows.append({
			"RecordID":        ds.getValueAt(r, "RecordID"),
			"RenbanGroupCode": ds.getValueAt(r, "RenbanGroupCode"),
			"Count":           ds.getValueAt(r, "Count"),
			"ShipDays":        ds.getValueAt(r, "ShipDays")
		})
	return {"data": rows, "columns": columns}

onChange.script:
# ---- RenbanGroup combined view: recordId change -> load detail ----
	# The grid onRowClick sets self.view.custom.recordId = event.value["RecordID"] (a
	# same-view prop write, NO navigation). This onChange fires on that write and
	# populates the in-view form. recordId==0 -> insert mode.
	# IG81-COMPAT: plain change script + T-SQL, identical on 8.1.52 and 8.3.
	log = system.util.getLogger("SPIKE")
	v = self.view if hasattr(self, "view") else self
	DB = "Inventory_Spike"
	c = v.custom
	cv = getattr(currentValue, "value", currentValue)
	recId = int(cv or 0)
	log.info("SPIKE RenbanGroup Detail recordId onChange fired: recId=%s origin=%s" % (recId, origin))

	if recId <= 0:
		c.statusMsg = "New renban group — enter details and Save."
		log.info("SPIKE RenbanGroup Detail: insert mode (recordId=0)")
		return

	getSql = ("SELECT IN_RENBAN_ID, VC_RENBAN_GROUP_CODE, VC_RENBAN_GROUP_COUNT, IN_SHIP_DAYS, "
	          "IN_SHIP_DAYS_MONDAY, IN_SHIP_DAYS_TUESDAY, IN_SHIP_DAYS_WEDNESDAY, "
	          "IN_SHIP_DAYS_THURSDAY, IN_SHIP_DAYS_FRIDAY, IN_SHIP_DAYS_SATURDAY "
	          "FROM INV_RENBAN_GROUP_MST WHERE IN_RENBAN_ID = ? -- IG-SITE: AND site_id = ?")
	ds = system.db.runPrepQuery(getSql, [recId], DB)
	if ds.rowCount == 0:
		c.statusMsg = "Renban group id %d not found." % recId
		log.warn("SPIKE RenbanGroup Detail: id %d not found" % recId); return
	def g(col):
		val = ds.getValueAt(0, col)
		return val if val is not None else ""
	def gi(col):
		val = ds.getValueAt(0, col)
		return int(val) if val is not None else 0
	c.form_code = g("VC_RENBAN_GROUP_CODE"); c.form_count = g("VC_RENBAN_GROUP_COUNT")
	c.form_shipdays = gi("IN_SHIP_DAYS")
	c.form_mon = gi("IN_SHIP_DAYS_MONDAY"); c.form_tue = gi("IN_SHIP_DAYS_TUESDAY")
	c.form_wed = gi("IN_SHIP_DAYS_WEDNESDAY"); c.form_thu = gi("IN_SHIP_DAYS_THURSDAY")
	c.form_fri = gi("IN_SHIP_DAYS_FRIDAY"); c.form_sat = gi("IN_SHIP_DAYS_SATURDAY")
	c.statusMsg = "Editing renban group %s (id %d)." % (c.form_code, recId)
	log.info("SPIKE RenbanGroup Detail loaded id=%d code=%s count=%s shipdays=%s" % (recId, c.form_code, c.form_count, c.form_shipdays))

# Re-run RenbanGroup/list. Bumping runNonce changes the gridModel expression input.
	self.view.custom.runNonce = (self.view.custom.runNonce or 0) + 1
	system.util.getLogger("SPIKE").info("RenbanGroup search -> runNonce=" + str(self.view.custom.runNonce))

# Row select -> SAME-VIEW prop write (single-view decision; NO navigation).
	# event.value is the row data in IA 8.1. Set custom.recordId, which fires the
	# custom.recordId onChange load script (D2: RecordID is IN_RENBAN_ID, never the code).
	log = system.util.getLogger("SPIKE")
	try:
		recId = event.value["RecordID"]
	except Exception:
		recId = event.value["RecordID"] if hasattr(event, "value") else None
	if recId is None:
		log.warn("SPIKE RenbanGroup list row click: no RecordID in event")
		return
	log.info("SPIKE RenbanGroup list -> open Detail recordId=%s" % recId)
	self.view.custom.recordId = int(recId)

props.text: Click a row to edit in the panel at right. Server-side LIKE search on code. Single combined view — row-select is an in-view prop write, no navigation. Counter is zero-padded to 3 chars on save. Site param plumbed; IG-SITE predicate commented until the Postgres phase.

config.script:
# ---- RenbanGroup Save (insert-or-update) ----
	# recordId==0 -> insert; >0 -> update. On success: flip recordId to the saved id
	# (edit mode) and refresh the grid by bumping runNonce (same-view, no navigation).
	log = system.util.getLogger("SPIKE")
	DB = "Inventory_Spike"
	c = self.view.custom
	# ---- SERVER-SIDE WRITE GATE (M4 P15 sweep — the H3 hole-closer) ----
	# auth.requireWrite resolves the caller's roles FROM THE SESSION (gateway-side, NOT a client
	# prop) and authorizes ProductionControl|Admin, raising AuthError on deny — BEFORE any
	# system.db write. A forged client prop or an anonymous session is rejected HERE, not by the
	# UI. This closes the reintroduced legacy H3 hole (the write was previously authorized client-
	# side only). Same gate the Sites Save/Delete/New carry (gen_sites_view.py rule #1).
	import auth as A
	try:
		A.requireWrite(self.session)
	except A.AuthError, e:
		c.statusMsg = "DENIED (server-side): " + unicode(e)
		system.util.getLogger("SPIKE").warn("SPIKE RenbanGroup Save DENIED (server-side gate): " + unicode(e)); return
	recId = int(c.recordId or 0)
	siteId = int(c.siteId or 1)   # IG-SITE: plumbed; predicate commented (D1)

	code = (c.form_code or "").strip()
	rawCount = unicode(c.form_count or "").strip()

	# ---- validation (client-side fast-fail; DB unique index is the backstop) ----
	# NOTE: VC_RENBAN_GROUP_CODE is varchar(5) -> cap at 5 (no fixed-length==N rule).
	if code == "":
		c.statusMsg = "Renban group code is required."
		log.info("SPIKE RenbanGroup save REJECTED: blank code"); return
	if len(code) > 5:
		c.statusMsg = "Renban group code must be 5 characters or fewer."
		log.info("SPIKE RenbanGroup save REJECTED: code len=%d" % len(code)); return

	# ---- counter: legacy left-pads the typed value to exactly 3 chars before save
	# (1->"001", 12->"012"). Require numeric; documented 0-999 sanity check (minor
	# improvement over legacy which had no hard range). Then pad with "%03d".
	if rawCount == "":
		countStr = "000"   # blank -> 000 (legacy padded a blank/zero the same way)
	else:
		try:
			countNum = int(rawCount)
		except Exception:
			c.statusMsg = "Renban count must be numeric."
			log.info("SPIKE RenbanGroup save REJECTED: non-numeric count=%r" % rawCount); return
		if countNum < 0 or countNum > 999:
			c.statusMsg = "Renban count must be between 0 and 999."
			log.info("SPIKE RenbanGroup save REJECTED: count out of range=%d" % countNum); return
		countStr = "%03d" % countNum
	# write the padded value back to the field so the UI reflects what was saved
	c.form_count = countStr

	def toInt(val):
		try:
			return int(val) if val not in (None, "") else 0
		except Exception:
			return 0
	shipDays = toInt(c.form_shipdays)
	mon = toInt(c.form_mon); tue = toInt(c.form_tue); wed = toInt(c.form_wed)
	thu = toInt(c.form_thu); fri = toInt(c.form_fri); sat = toInt(c.form_sat)

	excludeId = recId if recId > 0 else 0
	chkSql = ("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM INV_RENBAN_GROUP_MST "
	          "WHERE VC_RENBAN_GROUP_CODE = ? AND IN_RENBAN_ID <> ? -- IG-SITE: AND site_id = ?")
	dup = system.db.runPrepQuery(chkSql, [code, excludeId], DB)
	if dup.rowCount > 0 and int(dup.getValueAt(0, 0)) > 0:
		c.statusMsg = "Renban group code already exists."
		log.info("SPIKE RenbanGroup save REJECTED: dup code=%s" % code); return

	audit = ("CONVERT(char(8),GETDATE(),112) "
	         "+ SUBSTRING(CONVERT(varchar,GETDATE(),114),1,2) + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(varchar,GETDATE(),114),4,2) "
	         "+ SUBSTRING(CONVERT(varchar,GETDATE(),114),7,2) + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(varchar,GETDATE(),114),10,2)")

	try:
		if recId == 0:
			insSql = ("INSERT INTO INV_RENBAN_GROUP_MST (VC_RENBAN_GROUP_CODE, VC_RENBAN_GROUP_COUNT, IN_SHIP_DAYS, "
			          "IN_SHIP_DAYS_MONDAY, IN_SHIP_DAYS_TUESDAY, IN_SHIP_DAYS_WEDNESDAY, IN_SHIP_DAYS_THURSDAY, "
			          "IN_SHIP_DAYS_FRIDAY, IN_SHIP_DAYS_SATURDAY, VC_ADD) "
			          "VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?, " + audit + "); "
			          "SELECT CAST(SCOPE_IDENTITY() AS int) AS newId")
			rs = system.db.runPrepQuery(insSql, [code, countStr, shipDays, mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat], DB)
			newId = int(rs.getValueAt(0, 0))
			c.statusMsg = "Inserted renban group %s (id %d, count %s)." % (code, newId, countStr)
			log.info("SPIKE RenbanGroup INSERT ok: code=%s count=%s newId=%d" % (code, countStr, newId))
			c.runNonce = (c.runNonce or 0) + 1   # refresh grid (same-view)
			c.recordId = newId                    # flip to edit mode -> fires onChange reload
		else:
			# audit column has the underscore for RenbanGroup: VC_LAST_UPDATE (same as Size)
			updSql = ("UPDATE INV_RENBAN_GROUP_MST SET VC_RENBAN_GROUP_CODE=?, VC_RENBAN_GROUP_COUNT=?, IN_SHIP_DAYS=?, "
			          "IN_SHIP_DAYS_MONDAY=?, IN_SHIP_DAYS_TUESDAY=?, IN_SHIP_DAYS_WEDNESDAY=?, IN_SHIP_DAYS_THURSDAY=?, "
			          "IN_SHIP_DAYS_FRIDAY=?, IN_SHIP_DAYS_SATURDAY=?, "
			          "VC_LAST_UPDATE = " + audit + " "
			          "WHERE IN_RENBAN_ID = ? -- IG-SITE: AND site_id = ?")
			n = system.db.runPrepUpdate(updSql, [code, countStr, shipDays, mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, recId], DB)
			c.statusMsg = "Updated renban group %s (count %s, %d row)." % (code, countStr, n)
			log.info("SPIKE RenbanGroup UPDATE ok: id=%d code=%s count=%s rows=%d" % (recId, code, countStr, n))
			c.runNonce = (c.runNonce or 0) + 1   # refresh grid (same-view)
	except Exception, e:
		msg = unicode(e)
		if "IX_INV_RENBAN_GROUP_MST" in msg or "duplicate key" in msg.lower() or "UNIQUE" in msg.upper():
			c.statusMsg = "Renban group code already exists."
			log.info("SPIKE RenbanGroup save: unique-index backstop fired for code=%s" % code)
		else:
			c.statusMsg = "Save failed: %s" % msg
			log.warn("SPIKE RenbanGroup save FAILED: %s" % msg)

# ---- RenbanGroup Delete — D3 RESTRICT gate (R1-critical) ----
	# refCount counts BOTH INV_PARTS_STOCK_MST AND INV_PARTS_STOCK_MST_HIST by
	# IN_RENBAN_ID. The live DELETE_RenbanGroupCode trigger only nullifies the current
	# parts' IN_RENBAN_ID and IGNORES _HIST (which also carries IN_RENBAN_ID) — so
	# RESTRICT on both prevents dangling history. Block on any non-zero total; NEVER
	# reach the trigger while references exist.
	log = system.util.getLogger("SPIKE")
	DB = "Inventory_Spike"
	c = self.view.custom
	# ---- SERVER-SIDE WRITE GATE (M4 P15 sweep — the H3 hole-closer) ----
	# auth.requireWrite resolves the caller's roles FROM THE SESSION (gateway-side, NOT a client
	# prop) and authorizes ProductionControl|Admin, raising AuthError on deny — BEFORE any
	# system.db write. A forged client prop or an anonymous session is rejected HERE, not by the
	# UI. This closes the reintroduced legacy H3 hole (the write was previously authorized client-
	# side only). Same gate the Sites Save/Delete/New carry (gen_sites_view.py rule #1).
	import auth as A
	try:
		A.requireWrite(self.session)
	except A.AuthError, e:
		c.statusMsg = "DENIED (server-side): " + unicode(e)
		system.util.getLogger("SPIKE").warn("SPIKE RenbanGroup Delete DENIED (server-side gate): " + unicode(e)); return
	recId = int(c.recordId or 0)
	code = (c.form_code or "").strip()
	if recId == 0:
		c.statusMsg = "Nothing to delete (unsaved new record)."
		return
	refSql = ("SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INV_PARTS_STOCK_MST      WHERE IN_RENBAN_ID = ?) "
	          "     + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INV_PARTS_STOCK_MST_HIST WHERE IN_RENBAN_ID = ?) AS n")
	rs = system.db.runPrepQuery(refSql, [recId, recId], DB)
	n = int(rs.getValueAt(0, 0))
	log.info("SPIKE RenbanGroup refCount: id=%d code=%s n=%d" % (recId, code, n))
	if n > 0:
		c.statusMsg = ("Cannot delete renban group %s — still referenced by %d part(s)/history row(s). "
		               "Reassign or archive those rows first.") % (code, n)
		log.info("SPIKE RenbanGroup DELETE BLOCKED: id=%d code=%s refs=%d" % (recId, code, n)); return
	try:
		delN = system.db.runPrepUpdate("DELETE FROM INV_RENBAN_GROUP_MST WHERE IN_RENBAN_ID = ? -- IG-SITE: AND site_id = ?", [recId], DB)
		log.info("SPIKE RenbanGroup DELETE ok: id=%d code=%s rows=%d" % (recId, code, delN))
		c.statusMsg = "Deleted renban group %s." % code
		c.form_code = ""; c.form_count = ""; c.form_shipdays = 0
		c.form_mon = 0; c.form_tue = 0; c.form_wed = 0; c.form_thu = 0; c.form_fri = 0; c.form_sat = 0
		c.runNonce = (c.runNonce or 0) + 1   # refresh grid (same-view)
		c.recordId = 0                        # back to insert mode
	except Exception, e:
		c.statusMsg = "Delete failed: %s" % unicode(e)
		log.warn("SPIKE RenbanGroup DELETE FAILED: %s" % unicode(e))

# Clear -> reset to a blank insert-mode form (recordId=0). Same-view, no navigation.
	c = self.view.custom
	c.form_code = ""; c.form_count = ""; c.form_shipdays = 0
	c.form_mon = 0; c.form_tue = 0; c.form_wed = 0; c.form_thu = 0; c.form_fri = 0; c.form_sat = 0
	c.recordId = 0
	c.statusMsg = "Cleared — ready for a new renban group."
	system.util.getLogger("SPIKE").info("SPIKE RenbanGroup form cleared")
